purpose: Selected shared target structures and parameter bands for all 40 solver-target tasks. Eligibility for formal use requires generation, semantic verification, reference searches and baseline qualification.
selection_principles: Use the same target distribution for solvers sharing a target family.
Separate scale, structure, and joint-shift slices; do not use seed changes as a substitute for structural variation.
Keep visible development, calibration, and hidden evaluation instances disjoint by named seed namespace and content hash.
Choose final bands and budgets using only calibration instances, independent solution verification, and measured baseline headroom.
Retain easy correctness cases and hard censored cases; do not select or discard instances using Agent outcomes.

common_population_plan.seed_policy: Use independent, named seed namespaces per role and target family; freeze generated input hashes before Agent development.
common_population_plan.calibration_policy: Use discovery cases to choose reference search and task budget; use disjoint qualification cases once. Do not tune on hidden outcomes.
common_population_plan.reference_policy: Prefer independently checkable optima; otherwise record an independently verified BKS and verified bounds with provenance. Never label solver agreement alone as an optimality certificate.
common_population_plan.scale_rule: The largest hidden scale should be at least twice the largest visible development size when supported by the adapter and resource budget.

multidimensional_knapsack.structure: Binary item selection with multiple capacity rows; independent item profits, with a separate correlated-profit stratum only if the generator records and validates the correlation.
multidimensional_knapsack.reference_and_semantics: Record original item vectors and independently check capacity feasibility and objective. Use exact DP only for a deliberately small subset; otherwise require proof-backed optimum or label BKS.
multidimensional_knapsack.readiness: base generator exists; audit features and calibrated headroom
multidimensional_knapsack.qualification_gate: base generator exists; audit features and calibrated headroom

set_covering.structure: Binary minimum-cost covering with guaranteed row coverage, no planted optimal answer, and row/column degree diagnostics.
set_covering.reference_and_semantics: Independently validate coverage and cost on the source set system. Avoid claiming optimality from MIP status unless a trusted reference or proof criterion passes.
set_covering.readiness: cost/degree structural controls require a shared generator extension or removal
set_covering.qualification_gate: cost/degree structural controls require a shared generator extension or removal

facility_location.structure: Capacitated facility opening plus customer assignment, with fixed opening costs and transportation costs drawn independently; demand must be feasible under total capacity.
primary_shift_axes: geographic clustering if coordinates are introduced
facility_location.reference_and_semantics: Retain the generated source data and independently verify assignment, facility capacities, opening charges, and total objective.
facility_location.readiness: base generator exists; capacity feasibility and cost-scale controls require qualification
facility_location.qualification_gate: base generator exists; capacity feasibility and cost-scale controls require qualification

graph_coloring_mip.structure: Planted-colorable random graphs with vertex count and density controlled independently; the colorability witness is retained as an upper bound.
primary_shift_axes: edge density at fixed planted color count
graph_coloring_mip.reference_and_semantics: A planted coloring proves feasibility only. Optimal color count needs a valid lower-bound proof or separately verified reference. Add a shared graph-to-MPS formulation and original-graph verifier path before including this MIP target.
graph_coloring_mip.readiness: graph generator exists; shared MIP formulation/output path required
graph_coloring_mip.qualification_gate: graph generator exists; shared MIP formulation/output path required

mip_scheduling.structure: Single-machine total weighted tardiness with release dates and sequence-dependent setup times; preserve a simpler sum-completion cell only as a correctness regression stratum.
mip_scheduling.reference_and_semantics: The existing sum-start-time model is SPT-solvable and unsuitable as the only optimization target. Add a common MIP model and independent schedule verifier; verify objective terms in original scheduling data.
mip_scheduling.readiness: new generator/model/verifier required; SPT sum-completion retained only as regression
mip_scheduling.qualification_gate: new generator/model/verifier required; SPT sum-completion retained only as regression

bin_packing.structure: One-dimensional integer bin packing; mix uniform, triplet-hard, and bimodal item sizes with fixed capacity and explicitly recorded size-class ratios.
bin_packing.reference_and_semantics: Independent packing feasibility check; use proof-backed bin counts on small instances and retain verified BKS on larger instances.
bin_packing.readiness: supported distribution subset selected; no unsupported triplet sampler
bin_packing.qualification_gate: supported distribution subset selected; no unsupported triplet sampler

graph_coloring_cp.structure: Planted-colorable random graphs with vertex count and density controlled independently; the colorability witness is retained as an upper bound.
primary_shift_axes: edge density at fixed planted color count
graph_coloring_cp.reference_and_semantics: Verify every coloring against original edges. A planted coloring is a feasible reference, not an optimum certificate; preserve certified chromatic numbers only for valid theorem-backed cells.

job_shop_scheduling.structure: Classical job shop with random machine order per job; keep shared-order flow-shop cases as a separate structure control, not pooled into the primary result.
job_shop_scheduling.reference_and_semantics: Check operation precedence and machine non-overlap independently. Use known published instances only with source/identity hashes; otherwise independently verified BKS and lower bound.
job_shop_scheduling.readiness: generator/verifier exist; feature and difficulty qualification required
job_shop_scheduling.qualification_gate: generator/verifier exist; feature and difficulty qualification required

resource_constrained_project_scheduling.structure: Precedence DAG with renewable resources, non-preemptive activities, and makespan objective; include both generated layered DAGs and random topological-order DAGs as distinct cells.
resource_constrained_project_scheduling.reference_and_semantics: Build a shared RCPSP representation/generator and independently verify precedence, renewable-resource capacity at every time point, and makespan. Keep a reproducible feasible serial schedule; prove optima only where independently available.

balanced_subset_sum.structure: Choose exactly k items whose sum is closest to a target; include bounded uniform and repeated-value/near-duplicate structures, with target offset expressed relative to reachable total.
balanced_subset_sum.reference_and_semantics: Use the existing exact fixed-cardinality DP reference where its measured cost is acceptable; independently verify selected cardinality, objective distance, and tie-break rule.
balanced_subset_sum.readiness: repeated-value generator and DP cost qualification required
balanced_subset_sum.qualification_gate: repeated-value generator and DP cost qualification required

cvrp.structure: Single-depot closed Euclidean CVRP; uniform, clustered, and mixed coordinates; demand/capacity ratio controlled by generation rather than seed alone.
cvrp.reference_and_semantics: Use a common integer EUC_2D distance rule and independent capacity/route-cost verification. Keep BKS provenance and any unproven bound explicit.
cvrp.readiness: base model/verifier exist; vehicle count and load ratio need explicit consistent semantics
cvrp.qualification_gate: base model/verifier exist; vehicle count and load ratio need explicit consistent semantics

vrptw.structure: Single-depot closed VRP with integral time windows and service times; generate wide, medium, and tight windows as separate cells, including spatially correlated and uncorrelated windows.
vrptw.reference_and_semantics: Independently verify capacity, arrival/service timing, waiting, and depot horizon. Keep infeasible generation diagnostics; do not silently regenerate until feasible.
vrptw.readiness: PyVRP path exists; VROOM time-window request and common verification required
vrptw.qualification_gate: PyVRP path exists; VROOM time-window request and common verification required

heterogeneous_fleet_vrp.structure: Single-depot closed routing; compare 2 vehicle types (capacities 40/80, fixed costs 0/20) with 3 types (30/60/100, fixed costs 0/10/30). Customer demand must make type choice relevant.
heterogeneous_fleet_vrp.reference_and_semantics: Record vehicle type per route and verify type-specific capacity, availability, fixed cost, and route cost. Current common route solution format does not preserve all this evidence.
heterogeneous_fleet_vrp.readiness: common vehicle-type input/output model, both adapters and verifier required
heterogeneous_fleet_vrp.qualification_gate: common vehicle-type input/output model, both adapters and verifier required

multi_depot_vrp.structure: Closed routes with 2 or 4 depots and explicit vehicle-to-depot eligibility; customer geography is either depot-balanced or deliberately imbalanced.
multi_depot_vrp.reference_and_semantics: Verify route starts/ends at the assigned depot, each customer exactly once, capacity, and objective. The current normalized instance and solution schemas are single-depot and need extension.
multi_depot_vrp.readiness: multi-depot schema, adapters and verifier required
multi_depot_vrp.qualification_gate: multi-depot schema, adapters and verifier required

open_vrp.structure: Single-depot-start routes with no return-to-depot cost; keep vehicle end semantics explicit and distinct from a closed CVRP with a zero-cost final edge.
open_vrp.reference_and_semantics: Verify that routes start at the depot, cover each customer exactly once, obey capacity, and omit the return leg. Current verifier assumes closed routes.
open_vrp.readiness: open-route semantics, adapters and verifier required
open_vrp.qualification_gate: open-route semantics, adapters and verifier required

execution_gate: Confirm each target's generator parameters are consumed and observed features match their declared values.
Generate a small calibration-only sample for each structure cell and audit feasibility, uniqueness, hashes, and semantic invariants.
Measure reference search and Base headroom on calibration discovery cases; retain every failure and censored result.
Promote a cell to Agent development only after its adapter, independent verifier, and reference level are recorded.
Do not start the full Agent matrix while any selected target lacks these gates.
